mapper.update: UPDATE CONTRACT_REVIEW_STEP SET STATUS = 'PENDING', CURRENT_ATTEMPT_NO = #{nextAttemptNo}, OUTPUT_RESOURCE_TYPE = NULL, OUTPUT_RESOURCE_ID = NULL, SAFE_REASON_CODE = NULL, STARTED_AT = NULL, COMPLETED_AT = NULL, VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1 WHERE STEP_ID = #{stepId} AND RUN_ID = #{runId} AND STATUS = 'FAILED' AND VERSION_NO = #{expectedVersion} AND CURRENT_ATTEMPT_NO = #{previousAttemptNo} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CONTRACT_REVIEW_STEP_ATTEMPT a WHERE a.RUN_ID = #{runId} AND a.STEP_ID = #{stepId} AND a.ATTEMPT_NO = #{previousAttemptNo} AND a.STATUS = 'FAILED')

UPDATE CONTRACT_REVIEW_RUN SET STATUS = 'RUNNING', COMPLETED_AT = NULL, FAILED_AT = NULL, UNKNOWN_AT = NULL, SAFE_REASON_CODE = NULL, VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1 WHERE RUN_ID = #{runId} AND VERSION_NO = #{expectedVersion} AND STATUS = #{expectedStatus} AND STATUS IN ('RUNNING', 'FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS USER_ID, USERNAME, REAL_NAME AS DISPLAY_NAME FROM SYS_USER WHERE ID = #{userId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.* FROM CONTRACT_REVIEW_STEP_ATTEMPT a JOIN CONTRACT_REVIEW_STEP s ON s.RUN_ID = a.RUN_ID AND s.STEP_ID = a.STEP_ID JOIN CONTRACT_REVIEW_RUN r ON r.RUN_ID = a.RUN_ID WHERE a.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND s.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND s.CURRENT_ATTEMPT_NO = a.ATTEMPT_NO AND r.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND a.LEASE_OWNER IS NULL AND a.LEASE_UNTIL IS NULL AND a.EXTERNAL_CALL_STATE = 'NOT_STARTED' ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.STEP_TYPE = 'SEMANTIC_AI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, a.LEASE_UNTIL, a.ATTEMPT_ID ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
